title: Wrong Item Claims: Delivery-Charge Refund Calculation Sheet
content:
Refund Operations calculation sheet for the wrong-shipment delivery refund on an approved Delivery Claims Wrong Item Claim.

**Calculation.** On a Wrong Item Claim the wrong-shipment delivery refund is the order's effective shipping fee and surcharge paid, times the share of the delivery charge the claim covers. A line-scope claim, of itself, covers no share of the delivery charge. The refund is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final figure.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| effective shipping fee | the shipping fee shown on the order — the fee charged after any waiver, as distinct from the list fee of the delivery service |
| surcharge | the surcharge shown on the order |
| share of the delivery charge the claim covers | the claim; a Wrong Item Claim is a line-scope claim |

## Assembly

- The wrong-shipment refund basis is the effective shipping fee plus the surcharge.
- The share covered and every other proportion of the wrong-shipment refund basis that is paid are multiplied together and applied once to the wrong-shipment refund basis, giving the refunded wrong-shipment charge; they do not act on one another's results.
- *Hypothetical:* a share covered of 50% and a proportion of 75% multiply to 37.5%, which applied once to a wrong-shipment refund basis of 16.00 USD gives a refunded wrong-shipment charge of 6.00 USD.
- Tax on the refunded wrong-shipment charge, where the order bears any, is added to it.
- Nothing is rounded along the way; the single rounding to the nearest cent falls on the amount booked.

## Worked figure (hypothetical order)

An order showing an effective shipping fee of 12.00 USD and a surcharge of 1.00 USD: 13.00 USD times the share the line-scope Wrong Item Claim covers, which is none, gives a wrong-shipment delivery refund of 0.00 USD.
